catalogue.note: Normalised copy of mobile/subs-wf-01 with the shared iPhone chrome. The 390×632 inside is scaled 1.0308 to 402 wide and cut once at y=431: the part above is pinned to the top, the part below to the bottom, the 127px between filled with the inside’s own background. Nothing inside is restyled. Built at Figma’s own 390 wide and own height: every size in the frame is a whole number, no scale to recover. Square and unframed: Figma’s 1px black outside stroke on the frame is left off, so the diff runs on the 390-wide region inside it (the export is 2px larger each way). Inter Regular and Bold, as Figma names them, from the Inter Variable 4.001 file on this Mac, embedded whole; the width probe shows Inter rendering. Every text box matches Figma’s position and size; flat colours are exact; what differs is glyph-edge antialiasing. Dashed rules are drawn as Figma draws them: one row above their slot, pattern fitted to the length with half a dash at each end.
